documentation.content:
CPU IS SUSTAINED ABOVE THE HPA TARGET.

This is only a problem if the HPA is NOT responding. If replicas are climbing, the system is working as designed and this alert is informational.

First command:
  kubectl get hpa orders-api -n orders

If TARGETS shows <unknown>: the HPA is blind and will never scale.
  kubectl top pods -n orders
    - top FAILS  -> metrics-server is down
    - top WORKS  -> resources.requests.cpu is unset (no denominator)
  See docs/AUTOSCALING.md

If the HPA is at maxReplicas: you are out of headroom. Either raise the ceiling
(costs money) or find out why each pod needs so much CPU.

If new pods are Pending: cluster capacity is the constraint, not the HPA.

NOTE: CPU is compressible. Exceeding the limit throttles rather than kills, so
the user-visible symptom is LATENCY, not errors - until upstream timeouts turn
it into 5xx.

conditions.displayName: CPU above 80% of request for 10 minutes
